The Patty Wagon can't cross the Trench. Walk with Spongeguh and Patguh to the west rim: Princess Mindy Guh is waiting there with something hairy.
Down, across the dark bottom and up again. Are the monsters roaring? Or... singing?
Dennis Mika is looking for a square and a star. Luckily you are two respectable gentlemen with a moustache. Right?
King Neptuguh's crown is in the souvenir shop of Shell City. And the drying lamp is already on...
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.banter.benen: Walk? On my own legs? Exciting.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.banter.lopen: The Patty Wagon can't cross the Trench. From here we walk, nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.beloning.snor: Mindy Guh ties a moustache of nibble chorus string for your guhs too! (Guh clothes: the Nibble Chorus Moustache)
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.hint.rand: Walk with Spongeguh and Patguh along the road to the east, up the hill, until the road ends at the Trench: %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.jacht.gepakt_h: Dennis shoves you back to halfway. Once more!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.jacht.gepakt_s: Dennis shoves you back. Once more: sprint!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.jacht.half: Halfway! If Dennis catches you now, you start here.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.jacht.kwijt: Dennis Mika lost you... Come back to the road east of the Trench and the chase goes on.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.jacht.regel: Follow the road to the town gate. Don't let Dennis catch you!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.jacht.uitleg: Dennis Mika is after you on his motorbike! Run (sprint!) along the road down the hill, through the gate of Shell City. If he catches you, he only shoves you back to the last rest point, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.jacht.weer: There's Dennis Mika again! Run, to the town gate!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.klik.cycloop: Come in, come in! Everything is dried, and everything is fun. Hehe.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.klik.monster.2: La la la... la? (he forgot the words)
I fancy an ice cream. I always fancy an ice cream.
Do you know where we're going? Me neither!
I am a man. I am a man. I am... what was I again?
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.klik.patguh.6_: Those monsters sing better than Octo.
I feel a sneeze coming on. Oh no, never mind.
My moustache is my best friend. After you.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.klik.patguh.7_: Why are we running? Oh right!
Souvenirs! I want one with my own face on it.
Do you think that shop sells ice cream too?
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.klik.patguh.8_: Sniff... I can cry another tear, you know.
I'm as dry as a crust.
What could be at the end of the road? A really deep gorge, they say!
Walking is just like driving, but with your feet, nyeg.
With a moustache I'm scared of nothing. Almost nothing.
Hold on to your moustache, Patguh. It's windy here.
What sweet monsters! I'll send them a postcard.
A little more climbing and we're at the top!
The road starts again at the top of the rim. Come on!
Do you hear an engine too?
That enormous boot... I'm not saying anything. But I'm thinking a lot.
The souvenir shop is the building with the scallop on its roof!
Roll that tear, buddy... I'm nearly a cracker...
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.monsters.omhoo: Cross the bottom and climb up along the east wall
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.traan.los: You wriggle loose. Go back to the drying table to try again.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.traan.nieuw.1: Don't worry, I've got plenty more!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.traan.nieuw.2: Boohoo... there you go, a fresh one.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.traan.regel: Tilt the table with WASD: roll the tear to the socket
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.traan.uitleg: You're stuck in the Cyclops' hand, but you can tilt the table! W, A, S and D tilt it away from you, to the left, towards you and to the right. Roll Patguh's tear along the wet trail (the blue dots) to the socket on the wall. Off the trail? Then Patguh just cries a new one. Sneak = let go.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg.traan.weer: Back under the drying lamp! Tilt the table with WASD and roll the tear to the socket.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.kort.5: Walk to the rim of the Trench
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.kort.6_: Climb up on the east side
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.kort.7: Up onto the east rim of the Trench
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.kort.8_: Roll the tear to the socket
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.5: The Patty Wagon can't cross the Trench. Walk with Spongeguh and Patguh along the road to the east, up the hill, until the road ends at a deep, dark gorge. Someone is waiting for you at the rim.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.6: Go down the zigzag path along the west wall to the dark bottom. That's where the monsters live... With a moustache you're scared of nothing. Right?
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.6_b: The monsters sang you on your way. Cross the bottom and climb the path up along the east wall.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.7: At the top of the east rim of the Trench, step onto the road. There's an engine coming...
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.7_b: Run! Dennis Mika is after you. Follow the road down the hill to the east, through the gate of Shell City.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.8: That enormous boot... The crown must be in the Cyclops' souvenir shop: the big building with the giant scallop on its roof, on the north side of the square of Shell City. Go inside.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.8_b: Under the drying lamp! Tilt the drying table with WASD and roll Patguh's tear along the wet trail to the socket on the wall.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.5: The west rim of the Trench, east of The Thug Tug
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.6: The zigzag path down, on the west wall of the Trench
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.6_: The path up on the east wall of the Trench
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.7: The east rim of the Trench, where the road to Shell City begins
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.7_: The gate of Shell City, east along the road
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.8: The souvenir shop (giant scallop on the roof), north of the square of Shell City
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.8_: The drying table at the back of the souvenir shop
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_cycloop.help: Help! He's picking us up like a bag of crisps!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_cycloop.huil: Don't cry, Spongeguh. Crying wastes your water. ...Sniff. I'm crying a tiny bit myself.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_cycloop.knis: Patguh... I'm getting so... crispy. I've never been this thirsty.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_cycloop.kroo: Spongeguh! There! On that little cushion! King Neptuguh's crown!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_cycloop.lamp: A nice little dry under the lamp. Tomorrow you'll be in the shop window. Hehehe.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_cycloop.nieu: Aaah. New souvenirs. A little holey cheese with a moustache. A little star. And a fresh little vads. What a lovely day.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_cycloop.plan: That sneaky Plankmika sold it here! Quick, let's take it home, then Mr. Krabguh is saved!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_cycloop.souv: Look at all these souvenirs! Dried starfish... dried cheeses... a dried... guh?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_cycloop.stop: ...then the socket goes fzzzt and the sprinklers come on! Will you help it roll? We can't move any more. We're crisps.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_cycloop.traa: Patguh! A tear! Water! If that tear reaches the socket...
Hm. Two respectable gentlemen with a moustache. Then I won't bother you any longer. Have a nice day, gentlemen.
We're up! We made it, Patguh. And nobody recognised us!
No sir. There's only us here: two respectable gentlemen. With a moustache.
Uh-oh. That's Dennis Mika, Plankmika's hired hand. Act really... normal. We're just two gentlemen.
Good afternoon. I'm looking for a square and a star. Did they happen to come by here?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_kijk_pad.tek: Down along the west wall, across the dark bottom, and up again along the east wall.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_kijk_rand.te: This is where the road ends: at the Trench. There, at the rim, someone is waiting for you.
Shell City Gifts & Stuff: the building with the giant scallop on its roof.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_knipoog_appa: And I don't have a flying bison. Walking it is, nyeg!
Hi Spongeguh! Hi Patguh! You know you could just fly, right?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_laars.au: ...Ow. Nothing wrong. I'm okay. I'm just a little... flatter.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_laars.laars: A diving boot. A really big diving boot... Patguh, I've got a funny feeling about that souvenir shop over there.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_laars.sleute: Ooh, souvenirs! I want a keyring with my own name on it!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_laars.voet: What WAS that? A really big foot?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_monsters.dan: Thank you, sweet monsters! Come on, Patguh: across the bottom, and up the other side!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_monsters.don: It's awfully dark down here... Patguh, are you holding my hand?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_monsters.han: Spongeguh... my hands are in my pockets.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_monsters.man: D-don't be scared, Patguh! We are MEN! ...Men with a very tiny little voice.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_monsters.moo: Sniff... That was the most beautiful thing I ever heard. After the ice cream truck.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_snor.ga: Go now, brave gentlemen! Through the Trench, and on to Shell City: that's where Daddy's crown is. Good luck, nyeg!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_snor.hallo: Psst! There you are! I'm Mindy Guh, King Neptuguh's daughter. Daddy mustn't know, but I've come to help you.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_snor.harig: Patguh... I suddenly feel so... hairy.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_snor.herkent: And the best part: with a moustache, nobody will recognise us!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_snor.kindere: Mr. Krabguh says we're only kids.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_snor.monster: Princess! We have to get through that Trench over there. But monsters live down there... and we're only... well. Us.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_snor.snor: Then let's make you MEN. With a moustache of nibble chorus string. Hold still, nyeg!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_sproeier.han: ...Is that a towel? For me? ...Thank you, little one.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_sproeier.ik: Me. Sorry. It was a really lovely tear, though.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_sproeier.kro: King Neptuguh's crown! Home we go, before the sun goes... er, before it gets dark... er. Home we go!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_sproeier.lev: I'm alive again! I'm not a keyring any more, nyeg!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_sproeier.nat: Nooo! My souvenirs! Everything is WET! Who's been crying in my shop?!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_sproeier.pie: At the pier, maybe? Someone by the Void Sea will know what to do. Come on!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_sproeier.ste: I'm a star again! A wet star!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_weg_sproeier.thu: But how do we get home? The Patty Wagon is on the wrong side of the Trench.
